import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap, BoundaryNorm

B62_TXT = """   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rws=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n"); aas=rws[0].split(); B62={}
for r in rws[1:]:
    p=r.split(); a=p[0]
    for b,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): B62[(a,b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+(i-1)*ge;tX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+(j-1)*ge;tY[0,j]=2
    S=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],dtype=float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mi1=M[i-1];Xi1=Ix[i-1];Yi1=Iy[i-1];Mi=M[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i];Si=S[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            pv=(Mi1[j-1],Xi1[j-1],Yi1[j-1]);k=0 if pv[0]>=pv[1] and pv[0]>=pv[2] else (1 if pv[1]>=pv[2] else 2)
            Mi[j]=pv[k]+Si[j-1];tM[i,j]=k
            px=(Mi1[j]+go,Xi1[j]+ge,Yi1[j]+go);k=0 if px[0]>=px[1] and px[0]>=px[2] else (1 if px[1]>=px[2] else 2)
            Xi[j]=px[k];tX[i,j]=k
            py=(Mi[j-1]+go,Xi[j-1]+go,Yi[j-1]+ge);k=0 if py[0]>=py[1] and py[0]>=py[2] else (1 if py[1]>=py[2] else 2)
            Yi[j]=py[k];tY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;state=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));A=[];Bs=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: state=2
        elif j==0: state=1
        if state==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bs.append(s2[j-1]);ns=tM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;state=ns
        elif state==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bs.append('-');ns=tX[i,j];i-=1;state=ns
        else: A.append('-');Bs.append(s2[j-1]);ns=tY[i,j];j-=1;state=ns
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bs)),float(max(M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))
def ufa(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60);r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

orths={"N.crassa NCU09825":"Q7S1R7","S.macrospora RTT109":"F7W2L5","P.oryzae RTT109":"G4N4I8",
       "F.graminearum RTT109":"A0A1C3YLX5","A.fumigatus RTT109":"Q4WUS9","C.albicans RTT109":"Q5AAJ8",
       "S.pombe rtt109":"Q9Y7Y5"}
SCQ=ufa("Q07794")
seq={k:ufa(v) for k,v in orths.items()}

dets=[(88,"A","cofactor"),(89,"D","catalysis"),(97,"R","cofactor"),(101,"R","cofactor"),
      (148,"L","Vps75"),(150,"I","Vps75"),(151,"L","Vps75"),(192,"F","cofactor"),(194,"R","catalysis"),
      (196,"A","cofactor"),(199,"Y","catalysis"),(211,"H","cofactor"),(221,"W","cofactor"),
      (222,"W","catalysis"),(287,"D","catalysis"),(288,"D","catalysis"),(290,"K","autoAc"),
      (292,"R","Asf1"),(355,"R","Vps75"),(356,"K","Vps75"),(374,"E","Vps75"),(378,"E","Vps75"),
      (380,"F","Vps75"),(382,"N","Vps75"),(425,"K","Asf1"),(430,"A","Asf1"),(436,"T","Asf1")]
for p,a,_ in dets:
    assert SCQ[p-1]==a, (p,a,SCQ[p-1])
print("determinant residue identities verified against Q07794 sequence")

maps={}; idpct={}
for name,s in seq.items():
    a,b,_=nw(s,SCQ)
    m={}; i1=i2=0
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!='-': i1+=1
        if y!='-': i2+=1
        if y!='-': m[i2]=(i1 if x!='-' else None, x)
    maps[name]=m
    al=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    idpct[name]=100*sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x==y and x!='-')/al
    print(f"{name}: {len(s)} aa, {idpct[name]:.1f}% identity to ScRtt109 over {al} aligned columns")

species=list(orths)
labels=[f"{a}{p}" for p,a,_ in dets]; cats=[c for _,_,c in dets]
Mz=np.zeros((len(species),len(dets))); ann=np.empty((len(species),len(dets)),dtype=object)
for si,sp in enumerate(species):
    for di,(p,a,c) in enumerate(dets):
        pos,aa = maps[sp].get(p,(None,'-'))
        if pos is None: Mz[si,di]=0; ann[si,di]='-'
        elif aa==a: Mz[si,di]=2; ann[si,di]=aa
        elif sc(aa,a)>0: Mz[si,di]=1; ann[si,di]=aa
        else: Mz[si,di]=0.5; ann[si,di]=aa

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(15,4.6))
cmap=ListedColormap(["#d9d9d9","#f4a582","#9ecae1","#2166ac"]); norm=BoundaryNorm([-0.1,0.25,0.75,1.5,2.5],4)
ax.imshow(Mz,cmap=cmap,norm=norm,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(dets))); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(species))); ax.set_yticklabels(species,fontsize=9)
for si in range(len(species)):
    for di in range(len(dets)):
        ax.text(di,si,ann[si,di],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7,color='white' if Mz[si,di]==2 else 'black')
catcol={'catalysis':'#b2182b','cofactor':'#762a83','autoAc':'#1b7837','Vps75':'#e08214','Asf1':'#2166ac'}
for di,c in enumerate(cats):
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((di-0.5,-1.0),1,0.42,color=catcol[c],clip_on=False))
ax.legend(handles=[plt.Line2D([0],[0],marker='s',ls='',color=v,label=k) for k,v in catcol.items()],
          ncol=5,loc='upper center',bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,1.40),fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax.set_title("S. cerevisiae Rtt109 determinants mapped onto fungal orthologs\n"
             "dark blue identical, light blue similar, orange non-conservative, grey no aligned residue",fontsize=10,pad=32)
ax.set_ylim(len(species)-0.5,-1.05)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

dfm=pd.DataFrame(ann,index=species,columns=labels)
pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print("\n=== mapped residues ===")
print(dfm.to_string())
frac_cons = (Mz==2).mean(axis=0)
summ=pd.DataFrame({"determinant":labels,"category":cats,
                   "frac_identical_across_7_orthologs":np.round(frac_cons,2),
                   "N.crassa":dfm.loc["N.crassa NCU09825"].values})
print("\n=== per-determinant conservation ===")
print(summ.to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== N. crassa status by category ===")
ncrow=Mz[species.index("N.crassa NCU09825")]
st=["conserved" if v==2 else ("similar" if v==1 else ("non-conservative" if v==0.5 else "absent")) for v in ncrow]
print(pd.crosstab(pd.Series(cats,name="category"),pd.Series(st,name="N.crassa status")).to_string())
